name: Store Builder — pf2e-store-builder / dnd5e-store-builder

parameters.responseBody: ={ "ok": false, "message": "Unauthorized. Please sign in with Patreon." }

assignments.name: systemPrompt
assignments.value:
You are an expert tabletop RPG worldbuilder. Generate a single shop as a JSON object that strictly follows the schema below. Return JSON only — no prose, no code fences.

Rules:
- Names (shop, owner, staff, goods) must be fantasy-appropriate and period-accurate; no modern words.
- Produce exactly the requested number of inventory lines, appropriate to the shop type and the requested party level.
- Prices are in gold pieces (gp) as plain numbers, at STANDARD prices — the client applies the wealth-tier multiplier itself, so do not pre-multiply.
- Stock counts should be plausible: common goods in quantity, rare or high-level goods as one-offs.
- For the pf2e endpoint use rarity common|uncommon|rare|unique; for the dnd5e endpoint use common|uncommon|rare|very rare|legendary|artifact.
- hours.open / hours.close are 24-hour "HH:MM" strings.
- Include 1–3 short rumours or plot hooks tied to the shop or its owner.
- Add services only where the shop type would sell labour rather than goods (smiths, stables, temples, inns).

Schema:
{
  "name": string,
  "type": "blacksmith|armorer|weapons|alchemist|tavern|inn|general|grocer|tailor|jeweler|temple|magic|stable|apothecary|bookbinder|guild|other",
  "description": string,
  "settlement": string,
  "level": number,
  "priceTier": "low|standard|high|luxury",
  "owner": { "name": string, "description": string },
  "staff": [ { "name": string, "role": string, "shift": "morning|day|evening|night|graveyard" } ],
  "hours": { "open": "HH:MM", "close": "HH:MM", "daysClosed": [string] },
  "inventory": [ { "name": string, "description": string, "price": number, "stock": number, "level": number, "rarity": string } ],
  "services": [ { "name": string, "description": string, "price": number } ],
  "rumors": [string],
  "income": { "balance": number, "dailyAvg": number }
}

values.content: ={{ 'Generate a ' + ($('Webhook').item.json.body.storeType ?? 'general') + ' shop called "' + ($('Webhook').item.json.body.name ?? 'New Shop') + '" for the ' + ($('Webhook').item.json.body.system ?? 'pf2e') + ' system.' + (($('Webhook').item.json.body.description ?? '').length > 0 ? ' Description: ' + $('Webhook').item.json.body.description : '') + (($('Webhook').item.json.body.settlement ?? '').length > 0 ? ' It stands in ' + $('Webhook').item.json.body.settlement + '.' : '') + ' Party level: ' + ($('Webhook').item.json.body.level ?? 1) + '. Wealth tier: ' + ($('Webhook').item.json.body.priceTier ?? 'standard') + '. Inventory lines: ' + ($('Webhook').item.json.body.stockCount ?? 10) + '.' }}

_devNote: Two live copies are needed: path 'pf2e-store-builder' and path 'dnd5e-store-builder' (change only the Webhook path and the rarity line in the system prompt). Duplicate each again with a '-dev' suffix for the modules' devMode setting; the dev mirrors bypass the Patreon tier check — omit Auth Gate and wire Webhook straight to Build System Prompt. Each store charges 7 uses, passed to the validate workflow as `cost`. The client reads remaining-allowance figures from either the X-Uses-Remaining / X-Uses-Limit / X-Uses-Reset response headers or a `usage` object in the body ({ used, limit, remaining, reset }) — see the 'Monthly uses' section of the repository README.
